summary: Introduce the canonical Item contract for every physical BOM/cost-bearing stand entity, make it a mandatory repository-agent/development entrypoint, and guard the contract itself through the universal change gate.

impactAnalysis.notes: Governance-only Item root contract. Full-system discovery surfaces for the change gate, developer entrypoint, architecture docs, historical audit evidence and candidate findings were reviewed and acknowledged. No catalog descriptor, runtime behavior, state schema, placement, renderer, persistence, BOM calculation or pricing implementation changes in this PR. F-015 remains open because side-insert runtime enforcement is intentionally not changed here; this PR only establishes the canonical future Item/behavior ownership rule. F-014 BOM classification is likewise not resolved by this governance change.

e2e.reason: This PR changes repository governance contracts and their machine-enforced document gate only; it does not change browser-visible behavior or any browser-impact domain.

risk.notes: The change intentionally broadens repository governance for future physical Item work. Runtime behavior is unchanged, but an incorrect contract could constrain future implementations, so the contract is guarded by tests and the universal architecture gate.

migration.notes: No persisted project schema or runtime Item state is migrated in this PR. The existing module/catalog model remains operational until a later implementation change explicitly adopts the Item runtime model.

rollback: Revert the Item governance PR to remove ITEM_CONTRACT.md, AGENTS.md, the development/architecture references, and the governance-document gate entries; runtime product behavior remains unchanged either way.
